assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamical mean-field theory made correlated-electron materials quantitatively intelligible and is a lasting conceptual and computational foundation.
assessment.attribution: The three proposed names represent the central formulation and establishment of the method.
assessment.maturity: Its predictions, numerical implementation, and connection to spectra have been tested across many correlated materials over decades.
uncertainties: Credit is necessarily selective within a broad international development of many-body methods.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The quantum spin Hall effect and topological-insulator concept revealed a new robust class of quantum matter with deep theoretical and experimental consequences.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele supplied the defining theory, while Molenkamp led a decisive experimental realization of edge transport.
assessment.maturity: The phenomena have been independently reproduced and developed into a major field.
uncertainties: The experimental credit is distributed among several important material platforms and groups.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Magnetic skyrmions established topological spin textures as experimentally accessible quasiparticles with emergent electrodynamics.
assessment.attribution: Tokura and Pfleiderer are strongly associated with the experimental discovery and establishment of chiral-magnet skyrmions.
assessment.maturity: The signatures, topology, and current-driven behavior have been extensively confirmed in many systems.
uncertainties: Earlier theoretical foundations and multiple experimental discoveries complicate any compact attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Room-temperature tunnel magnetoresistance converted a fundamental spin-dependent tunnelling effect into an exceptionally consequential technology.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names cover seminal observation, experimental demonstration, and the MgO-based advance enabling very large practical effects.
assessment.maturity: The effect is reproducible, physically well understood, and central to magnetic memory technologies.
uncertainties: The transition from early TMR to optimized MgO junctions involved a wider body of crucial work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Magic-angle graphene opened a powerful materials platform in which twist controls correlations, superconductivity, and topology.
assessment.attribution: Jarillo-Herrero led the landmark observation, and Bistritzer and MacDonald supplied the influential microscopic explanation of the magic angle.
assessment.maturity: The central flat-band phenomenology has been reproduced broadly and has reshaped moiré-material research.
uncertainties: The microscopic origin of some correlated phases, especially superconductivity, remains unsettled.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Spin ice made fractionalization and an emergent Coulomb phase concrete in magnetic crystals, a striking bridge between materials and gauge ideas.
assessment.attribution: Bramwell is central to the experimental establishment, and Castelnovo and Moessner to the monopole interpretation.
assessment.maturity: Characteristic correlations, excitations, and thermodynamics have received extensive independent experimental and theoretical support.
uncertainties: The lineage includes foundational contributions from additional experimental and theoretical researchers.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Conductance quantization provided a remarkably direct demonstration of quantum transport through controllable electronic channels.
assessment.attribution: The proposed researchers are closely linked to the independent pioneering quantum-point-contact experiments.
assessment.maturity: The quantized steps are a textbook, reproducible result and underpin modern mesoscopic physics.
uncertainties: Its status as a discrete discovery versus part of the broader development of mesoscopic transport deserves comparison with other mature candidates.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Spin-orbit torques revealed an efficient electrical route to manipulate magnetization and created a major direction in spintronics.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names made central experimental contributions to interfacial and spin-Hall torque switching.
assessment.maturity: The effects are robust across diverse heterostructures and have a clear physical framework and device relevance.
uncertainties: Mechanisms and priority are spread across spin Hall, Rashba-like, and interfacial torque contributions.
